files.review: Read full reasoning component and policy. Extracted ambient decisions/duration formatting into production reasoningPolicy.ts so pure policy tests no longer import rendering/markdown/SDK graphs. Native keyboard peer uses normal animated Motion. Pure finite decision cases and runtime timers are separate evidence.

Read complete question card and ChatContainer/Sidebar answer routing. Retained actual card, replaced reliance on global Motion passthrough with real Motion configured to skip interpolation for DOM tests. New regressions exposed duplicate final publication and stale shared typed-answer registration on unmount. Production claims question index synchronously, guards old option handlers, registers typed route in layout effect with identity-safe cleanup, and shows completed local answers until authoritative output lands. Mixed option/typed hydration pause retains partial answers; native Enter publishes one exact output. Integration follow-up: Replaced six mixed phrase pins/fake option clicks/Motion skipAnimation cases with two narrow React binding tests using the ALREADY public production pendingAnswerRef. Real layout effect disables/reinstalls routing while preserving prior typed answer, synchronous stateRef prevents duplicate final publication, and earlier card teardown cannot clear later card registration. No simulated click or Motion claim remains; native peer owns actual option keyboard selection.

Read complete chip/extraction callers. Removed local Tooltip replacement and class-name/spinner implementation oracles. Real Base UI tooltip/button tree now proves independent preview/remove callbacks, actionable disabled semantics for reading, and failure-only retry. Owned cleanup joins popup transitions. Native composer proof stages the real library asset and carries/removes its exact attachment identity. Integration follow-up: Removed trivial preview/remove/retry callback tests and labels. Actual media/composer/extraction browser journeys exercise the production attachment chip against controlled HTTP peers and real asset identity. No new wrapper/model introduced.

Read complete activity derivation/status component and Sidebar caller. Kept real state-to-copy decisions and live-region assertions, removed min-height CSS string as a geometry oracle. Tests claim activity state/copy only; production/native chat owns rendered layout. No fake service behavior or unreachable blueprint fixture introduced. Integration follow-up: Removed three rendered-text/role duplicate tests and happy-dom. Retained actual deriveChatActivity priority/state-to-copy behavior including completion vs closing stream, recovery, submission vs resumed stream and document reading.

Replaced entire mocked prompt/textarea suite with real ChatInput, PromptInputProvider, real BlueprintDocProvider holding validator/schema-admitted survey, actual BuilderSessionProvider and actual media/tooltip components. Controlled only usage HTTP peer; joined each request and popup cleanup. Tests cover trimmed single send, preserved disabled/oversized draft, actual focused credit tooltip, and access refresh arriving before async submit continuation. Native Chromium chooses stored library image, hides/restores production persistent composer, then Enter sends exact text+asset and clears both. Integration follow-up: Removed five simulated text/change/click/tooltip tests and their broad provider fixture. Extended existing native real ChatInput/PromptInput journey to prove oversized Enter preserves draft and no send; a one-shot submit event capture advances the ACTUAL BuilderSessionStore access owner before the actual async submit continuation; draft remains and restored authority can later send. Native existing hide/restore + selected asset exact send remain.

Read full Sidebar and composer ownership. Removed invented DraftAndAttachmentState component and CSS-class assertions that only proved a generic mounted div. Extracted production chatComposer.tsx holding actual persistent wrapper/fallback and activity policy, reducing unrelated inspector/SDK import graph. Kept pure short-viewport policy and real fallback callback tests. Replaced claimed draft/file retention with native real ChatInput+media picker+PromptInput through actual PersistentChatComposer. Host hide/restore is explicitly controlled; this does not claim full-app viewport behavior. Integration follow-up: Removed rendered label plus callback assertion and happy-dom. Kept the existing production fallback visibility and accepted-build composer gate decisions. Existing native real composer journey owns draft and selected-asset retention through hidden wrapper.

Kept five direct production planWorkflowRows projections with independent finite compaction/status/count outcomes. Removed happy-dom. Moved outline disclosure and materialization transition to native keyboard/browser proof.

Typed ToolUIPart fixtures cover single pending-to-complete action and breadcrumb, collapsed multi-call batch, nested historical completion issues, and stable thrown-error recovery without private traces. Existing lib/chat/toolSummary tests own action/state/error privacy projection. Extended native real nested Base UI disclosures with keyboard opening/closing and visible findings; historical completion fixture deliberately represents supported persisted transcript, not a current-generation tool call.

This remains a pure formatting/state-boundary contract, not proof that an app was generated.

External identity and Next navigation ports are controlled; usage/library HTTP peers remain below real fetching adapters and requests are joined. Read entire app card action/confirmation state machine and owning summary contract. Kept actual error-app recovery link, added real card confirmation/cancel/deleting/refusal flow using controlled async action boundary. Correct complete app status, no malformed ready fixture. Deferred action is settled/joined even on render/assertion failure; actual Motion skip-interpolation host preserves lifecycle and tooltips. Navigation retires during delete and returns with retry action after refusal; no database deletion claim. Integration follow-up: Removed fake delete callback and link/copy tests. Actual card focus/navigation/delete behavior is exercised by production authed app-card lifecycle and Project movement journeys using persisted rows. No test-only state abstraction introduced.

Read entire boundary and error reporter boundary. Real React render exception proves exact original Error plus source metadata reaches reporter once, unchanged owning screen remains failed, and changed reset key remounts healthy child. Reporter alone is controlled external telemetry; no error-boundary implementation is replaced. Real child throw is reported once; healthy replacement under same key remains captured; changed owning key mounts replacement. This is a narrow React lifecycle adapter, not geometry or user-interaction proof.
